findings.title: Google/Yandex message translation cache can return pre-edit text
findings.runtime_reproduction: Blocked: no remote translation request in this audit
findings.expected: Translation corresponds to the current source text and entities.
findings.actual: Message cache key omits the source version; cached originalText is not checked before translatedText is returned.
findings.impact: A successful result can describe superseded or opposite instructions.
findings.recovery: Changing the inherited provider clears the process cache; restarting also clears it. Code-traced, not newly exercised.
findings.decision: Invalidate or version the cache and isolate account/provider/request identity.
findings.acceptance: A controlled successful translation followed by an edit of the same peer/message/language returns the new result; changing entities, account or provider does not reuse stale results.

findings.title: Inherited Google/Yandex draft translation loses original text entities
findings.decision: Protect structured spans consistently or disclose losses before applying the translation.
findings.acceptance: Synthetic hidden links, code and formatting survive translation across supported providers; cancellation preserves the draft.

findings.title: Preference backup omits advanced device settings without naming the omission
findings.decision: Include suitable advanced device preferences or enumerate exclusions and provide restore verification.
findings.acceptance: Synthetic source and fresh destination profiles restore all included preferences, with explicit excluded categories. Existing omitted preferences are not described as deleted by import.

findings.title: Compatible filter scope editor requires internal typed chat identifiers
findings.decision: Add a conversation/topic picker while retaining compatible encoded scopes.
findings.acceptance: A user can choose a chat or topic by its visible identity and save an accurate scope without typing IDs.

findings.title: Undownloaded audio requires restarting transcription manually
findings.decision: Chain download and transcription with visible stages, cancellation and service consent.
findings.acceptance: One start handles a synthetic uncached audio item; cancellation prevents subsequent submission and repeated clicks do not duplicate requests.
